candidates.verdict: NOT promoted to a probability input (hand-verified 2026-10-25). It prices two fixtures the four production feeds miss. Row 1 agrees with production: Vitality Rising Bees vs Mental Rush, LGC Rising 2026 Playoffs, 7/17 vs 8/5 -> 64.8%/35.2%, against our published Polymarket-sourced 64.5%/35.5%. Row 2 contradicts it: Ground Zero vs Frank Esports, LCP 2027 Promotion, 1/67 vs 22/3 -> 89.1%/10.9% for Ground Zero, while our Elo says Frank Esports 61.7% and eGamersWorld (rating 448 v 530, 0-4 head-to-head) and rft.gg (0-9 head-to-head) both favour Frank Esports. One row in two agreeing is not enough to let an affiliate-rendered board override the model, so the disagreement is published on the Flagged page for review instead. research/betting-sources.md §26.
